title: Saquon Barkley out, Jalen Hurts (calf) added to report but will play

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Saquon Barkley out, Jalen Hurts (calf) added to report but will play
sources.description: The Eagles will be shorthanded once again in Week 5, and their quarterback now has an injury issue — though it won’t keep him from playing.
